ja193:1.1: This is surely her, I am no other,
ja193:1.2: This one had his hands cut off, no other,
ja193:1.3: What she said was: ‘He is my youthful husband’,
ja193:1.4: Women should be killed, there is no truth in women.
ja193:2.1: Beat this despicable one with a club,
ja193:2.2: A violent wretch, who goes with others’ wives.
ja193:2.3: This is a wicked and a faithless wife,
ja193:2.4: While still living cut off her ears and nose!
